value_case.statement: Prevent client lighting crashes from foreign-world hosted chunks and wrong-coordinate empty render placeholders.
acceptance: Regression reproduces and prevents foreign chunk lighting across different heights and minY.
Reproduce exact ScalableLux negative cache index and reject wrong-coordinate or placeholder lighting chunks while preserving real empty terrain.
Hosted lighting still updates; no clipping, swallowed exceptions, or global lighting disable.
Exact artifact and runtime acceptance limitations recorded.
